questions.question: What did the Israelites do on the day of confession?
options: Held a great feast with much music, song, and dancing
Fasted, wore sackcloth, and confessed their sins
Built a new altar of uncut stones
Marched out to war against their enemies
questions.answer: Fasted, wore sackcloth, and confessed their sins

questions.question: What does the long prayer in chapter 9 recount?
options: The detailed plans for the rebuilding of the courts of the temple
A long and very complete list of all of the kings who had ruled over Judah
The future glory that was promised to the great city of Jerusalem
God's faithfulness throughout Israel's history despite their rebellion
questions.answer: God's faithfulness throughout Israel's history despite their rebellion
